description: This file contains functions related to managing system paths, specifically for retrieving content and CA certificates paths within the starboard common namespace. It includes functions to get paths from subdirectories, prepend content paths, and handle fallbacks if paths are unavailable.

methods.name: GetCACertificatesPathFromSubdir
methods.description: Constructs the path to CA certificates based on a subdirectory within the content directory.

methods.name: PrependContentPath
methods.description: Prepends the system content directory path to a given relative path.

methods.name: GetCACertificatesPath
methods.description: Returns the path to CA certificates, trying a specific subdirectory first and falling back if necessary.

methods.name: GetCACertificatesPath
methods.description: Returns the default CA certificates path, with fallback logic if initial path is invalid.
